mapper.select: SELECT type_id AS typeId, name, description, reserved_type_id AS reservedTypeId FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY type_id
SELECT type_id AS typeId, name, description, reserved_type_id AS reservedTypeId FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND type_id = #{typeId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.types (game_id, type_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, description, reserved_type_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{reservedTypeId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, reserved_type_id = EXCLUDED.reserved_type_id, updated_at = NOW()
